body.heading: Where in the world is Tonga?
paragraphs: Tonga is a country in Polynesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Tonga is Nuku'alofa.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Tonga speak Tongan and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Tonga is the Tongan pa'anga.

body.heading: How big is Tonga?
paragraphs: Tonga covers about 747 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Each winter, humpback whales come to Tonga's sheltered Vava'u islands to calve — Tonga is one of the few places families can swim with them under strict rules.
Tongatapu holds the Ha'amonga trilithon, a giant stone gateway from 1200 AD, royal tombs — and blowholes that roar along the south coast.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Tonga on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
